snippet.title: (OLD) Angeline Era Trailer: Bump the World (Demo out now!)
snippet.description:
Free Demo available 5/9 (When this trailer drops)! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393920/Angeline_Era/ 

Full game coming 2025 to PC/Mac. Consoles eventually.

Angeline Era is a fast-paced, nonlinear, 3D Action-Adventure with intense boss fights! Venture into an ancient land of Angels and Fae, as you "bumpslash" and shoot through a lush world filled with outrageous hazards, charming creatures, and unholy abominations.

Everything by Melos Han-Tani and Marina Kittaka! The duo behind Anodyne 1&2, Even the Ocean, Sephonie, and more... support independent creators! Buy our games on Steam, Itch, Switch, PS5, Xbox, etc.

Listen to the demo's music (Releasing 5/16): 
Bandcamp: https://htch.bandcamp.com/album/angeline-era-demo-ost
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/7elplWPi6wDuU4kwEpliet
